          "text": "# M46: A Cluster with a Second Story\n\n*In Puppis, a spray of stars shares the eyepiece with a ghostly-looking nebula\u2014and the view offers a lesson in cosmic perspective.*\n\nOn a clear late-winter evening, turn south and find M46, the open cluster catalogued as NGC 2437.
